name: macro
description: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.
one_liner: An all-in-one work app that replaces Slack, email, Notion, and a CRM with one tool where everything is linked together and shared with your team's AI.
buyer: A startup founder or ops lead frustrated with paying for and switching between five different SaaS tools every day.
business_use_cases: A 10-person startup replaces its Slack-plus-Notion-plus-HubSpot stack with it to cut SaaS spend and keep everything searchable in one place.
An agency owner uses the shared AI memory feature so every new hire's AI assistant instantly knows a client's history from day one.
A solo consultant self-hosts it as a lightweight personal CRM, inbox, and task manager instead of paying for four separate subscriptions.

money_ideas.idea: Hosted team plan priced per seat (this is already the company's own commercial model, per their site).
Migration and onboarding service helping teams move off their current tool stack onto it.

steal_this: There's not much white space to build a competing product on since it's already a funded company's hosted SaaS; the real opportunity is reselling migration and onboarding services to teams switching over.
